clean_rebuild_output_parity.scope: Clean frozen source rebuild; full6object4methods and512objectSIMD4 outputs compared with formal first output. Inputs copied and SHA256 checked.

soak_harness_checks.scope: CPU-only synthetic telemetry audit; no soak or GPU execution

scope_notes: Warmup timings are counted but do not contain GT-evaluated result records.
Exact ordered parity is against the original full GPU path, not CPU double arithmetic.
GPU allocation compares named buffer lengths and compiled static threadgroup bytes; not physical VRAM.
Fine source_samples are derived sampler calls, not measured hardware traffic.
Signed timestamp residuals are retained; negative residuals are not silently clamped.
Failed speed or independent-GT gates are evidence, not audit-integrity failures.

soak.limitation: Only the first full vector has independent GT/parity replay; 107 later calls preserve native exact attestations, not independently archived full vectors. Five minutes, fixed scene, one device: no long-term or real-video claim.

interpretation: Mode4 leaves fine_search the largest stage for large scenes; coarse_peaks is next, not eliminated.
Mode3 source-statistics reuse is slower on primary scenes: reduced arithmetic alone does not guarantee faster GPU scheduling/access.
upload_ms measures host memcpy into shared buffers; readback_ms measures post-wait status/result collection. Neither is a direct PCIe/DMA measurement.
wait_ms overlaps the same device execution interval; it is not an additional transfer cost to add to device_ms.
GPU private/shared copies and output work are already within command/stage intervals. These measurements do not establish CUDA transfer cost.
Profile runs are diagnostic; formal unprofiled runs decide speed gates.

soak.parity_scope: First full ordered matches AND proposals compared independently to formal mode-0 GPU result. Every JSONL row carries the native runner exact-equality attestation against that first result; repeated full vectors are not archived.
soak.accuracy_scope: Independent GT applies directly to the archived first output. Subsequent outputs are covered by native exact comparison; no independent GT reconstruction from telemetry is claimed.
soak.memory_scope: RSS is whole-process memory. gpu_bytes is retained named Metal buffer lengths; scratch/diagnostic allocations are subsets. Static threadgroup storage, counter capacity and transient CPU resolve payload are separate scopes, not additive.
soak.limitation: Five minutes on one fixed 512-object scene, including at least one teardown/recreation, is bounded integrity evidence and not long-term stability, real-video or cross-device proof.

archive_replay.scope: Extracted archives and frozen tools; six benchmark, cross-version and soak summaries replayed. No GPU measurements rerun by this script.
